name: rapidnative
description: Build mobile apps (iOS, Android and web) from a chat. Describe your idea and get a live app you can open on your phone.

interface.longDescription: Turn an idea into a real mobile app, right from the chat. Describe the app you want, for your business, a side project or a startup, and RapidNative builds it: screens, navigation, a database and sign-in. Open the live preview in your browser or on your phone with Expo Go, ask for changes in plain words, and publish to Android and the app stores from the RapidNative editor. No coding needed.
